current.description: Cycle 9 shifts the fleet from reactive productionization to proactive, self-optimizing behavior. Goals focus on: (1) predictive operations - anticipating failures and resource needs before they occur, (2) knowledge synthesis - building a shared semantic layer so agents can reason over fleet state without re-deriving context each pass, (3) delivery value - making the portal and fleet produce outputs a human would find useful (reports, insights, automated decisions). Each agent's 10 goals should advance at least one of these three pillars.
